arxiv-1911-00870.title: MadNet: Using a MAD Optimization for Defending Against Adversarial Attacks
arxiv-1911-00870.creator: Shai Rozenberg, Gal Elidan, Ran El-Yaniv
arxiv-1911-00870.description: Abstract This paper is concerned with the defense of deep models against adversarial attacks. Inspired by the certificate defense approach, we propose a maximal adversarial distortion (MAD) optimization method for robustifying deep networks. MAD captures the idea of increasing separability of class clusters in the embedding space while decreasing the network sensitivity to small distortions.

arxiv-2003-02033.title: Master-slave synchronization of Bose-Einstein condensate in 1D tilted bichromatical optical lattice
arxiv-2003-02033.creator: E. Tosyali ? {}^{\textsf{\footnotesize{\mbox{?}}}}, F. Aydogmus ? {}^{\textsf{\footnotesize{\mbox{?}}}}
arxiv-2003-02033.description: Abstract This paper investigates the synchronization of chaotic behavior in a model of Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) held in a 1D tilted bichromatical optical lattice potential by using the active control technique. The synchronization is presented in the master-slave configuration which implies that the master system evolves freely and drives the dynamics of the slave system.

arxiv-2206-11867.title: Lifelong Learning Natural Language Processing Approach for Multilingual Data Classification
arxiv-2206-11867.creator: Jędrzej Kozal, Michał Leś, Paweł Zyblewski, Paweł Ksieniewicz, Michał Woźniak
arxiv-2206-11867.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jędrzej Kozal, Michał Leś, Paweł Zyblewski, Paweł Ksieniewicz, Michał Woźniak. The abundance of information in digital media, which in today’s world is the main source of knowledge about current events for the masses, makes it possible to spread disinformation on a larger scale than ever before. Consequently, there is a need to develop novel fake news detection approaches capable of adapting to changing factual contexts and generalizing previously or concurrently acquired knowledge.

arxiv-2208-01208.title: Communication network dynamics in a large organizational hierarchy
arxiv-2208-01208.creator: Nathaniel Josephs, Sida Peng, Forrest W. Crawford, Nathaniel Josephs, Sida Peng, Forrest W. Crawford, Nathaniel Josephs, Sida Peng, Forrest W. Crawford, Nathaniel Josephs, Sida Peng, Forrest W. Crawford
arxiv-2208-01208.description: Abstract Most businesses impose a supervisory hierarchy on employees to facilitate management, decision-making, and collaboration, yet routine inter-employee communication patterns within workplaces tend to emerge more naturally as a consequence of both supervisory relationships and the needs of the organization. What then is the relationship between a formal organizational structure and the emergent communications between its employees?

arxiv-2209-01977.title: A new collision avoidance model with random batch resolution strategy
arxiv-2209-01977.description: Abstract . Research on crowd simulation has important and wide range of applications. The main difficulty is how to lead all particles with a same and simple rule, especially when particles are numerous. In this paper, we firstly propose a two dimensional agent-based collision avoidance model, which is a N N -particles Newtonian system.

arxiv-2304-11091.title: Feature-Based Generalized Gaussian Distribution Method for NLoS Detection in Ultra-Wideband (UWB) Indoor Positioning System
arxiv-2304-11091.creator: Fuhu Che, Qasim Zeeshan Ahmed, Jaron Fontaine, Ben Van Herbruggen, Adnan Shahid, Eli De Poorter, Pavlos I. Lazaridis
arxiv-2304-11091.description: Abstract Non-Line-of-Sight (NLoS) propagation condition is a crucial factor affecting the precision of the localization in the Ultra-Wideband (UWB) Indoor Positioning System (IPS). Numerous supervised Machine Learning (ML) approaches have been applied for NLoS identification to improve the accuracy of the IPS.

arxiv-2312-12370.title: Hilton-Milnor’s theorem in ∞ \infty -topoi.
arxiv-2312-12370.creator: Samuel Lavenir
arxiv-2312-12370.description: Abstract . In this note we show that the classical theorem of Hilton-Milnor on finite wedges of suspension spaces remains valid in any ∞ \infty -topos. Our result relies on a version of James’ splitting proved in [ DH21 ] and uses only basic constructions native to any model of ∞ \infty -categories. 1.

arxiv-2409-03285.title: Open charm mesons in variational scheme and HQET
arxiv-2409-03285.creator: K. K. Vishwakarma, Ritu Garg, Alka Upadhyay
arxiv-2409-03285.description: Abstract The charm ( D D ) and charm-strange ( D s D_{s} ) mesons are investigated in a variational scheme using Gaussian trial wave functions. The Hamiltonian contains Song and Lin potential with a constant term dependent on radial and orbital quantum numbers.

arxiv-2502-02770.title: Twilight: Adaptive Attention Sparsity with Hierarchical Top- p p Pruning
arxiv-2502-02770.creator: Chaofan Lin, Jiaming Tang, Shuo Yang, Hanshuo Wang, Boyu Tian, Ion Stoica, Song Han, Mingyu Gao, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, gaomy@tsinghua.edu.cn
arxiv-2502-02770.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Chaofan Lin, Jiaming Tang, Shuo Yang, Hanshuo Wang, Boyu Tian, Ion Stoica, Song Han, Mingyu Gao, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, gaomy@tsinghua.edu.cn. Leveraging attention sparsity to accelerate long-context large language models (LLMs) has been of great importance recently. However, most existing sparse attention algorithms use a fixed budget of how many tokens to use in their computations.

arxiv-2503-16499.title: Stakeholder Perspectives on Whether and How Social Robots Can Support Mediation and Advocacy for Higher Education Students with Disabilities DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Journal: JACM Volume: 37 4 111 8 CCS: Human-centered computing Accessibility design and evaluation methods CCS: Social and professional to
arxiv-2503-16499.creator: Alva Markelius, Julie Bailey, Jenny L. Gibson, Hatice Gunes
arxiv-2503-16499.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alva Markelius, Julie Bailey, Jenny L. Gibson, Hatice Gunes. This paper presents an iterative, participatory, empirical study that examines the potential of using artificial intelligence, such as social robots and large language models, to support mediation and advocacy for students with disabilities in higher education.

arxiv-2505-24485.title: Neutrino emission from neutron star matter
arxiv-2505-24485.creator: Omar Benhar † and Lucas Tonetto ‡
arxiv-2505-24485.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Omar Benhar † and Lucas Tonetto ‡. The temperature of a newly formed neutron star is believed to be as high as 10 11 10^{11} K, corresponding to a thermal energy of about 10 10 MeV.

arxiv-2506-19514.title: Rare-earth atoms on Nb(110) as a platform to engineer topological superconductivity
arxiv-2506-19514.creator: David Antognini Silva, Yu Wang, Nicolae Atodiresei, Felix Friedrich, Stefan Blügel, Matthias Bode, Philipp Rüßmann, Artem Odobesko
arxiv-2506-19514.description: Abstract Helical spin textures in one-dimensional magnetic chains on superconductors can enable topological superconductivity and host Majorana zero modes, independent of the presence of intrinsic spin–orbit coupling. Here, we show that gadolinium (Gd) adatoms, possessing large 4f magnetic moments when placed on a Nb(110) surface, establish indirect exchange interactions mediated by valence electrons, manifesting as Yu–Shiba–Rusinov states.

arxiv-2510-22948.title: PASS-Enhanced MEC: Joint Optimization of Task Offloading and Uplink PASS Beamforming
arxiv-2510-22948.description: Abstract A pinching-antenna system (PASS)-enhanced mobile edge computing (MEC) architecture is investigated to improve the task offloading efficiency and latency performance in dynamic wireless environments. By leveraging dielectric waveguides and flexibly adjustable pinching antennas, PASS establishes short-distance line-of-sight (LoS) links while effectively mitigating the significant path loss and potential signal blockage, making it a promising solution for high-frequency MEC systems.

arxiv-2512-08674.title: Multi - Agent Intelligence for Multidisciplinary Decision - Making in Gastrointestinal Oncology
arxiv-2512-08674.creator: Rongzhao Zhang, Junqiao Wang, Shuyun Yang, Mouxiao Bian, Chihao Zhang, Dongyang Wang, Qiujuan Yan, Yun Zhong, Yuwei Bai, Guanxu Zhu, Kangkun Mao, Miao Wang, Chao Ding, Renjie Lu, Lei Wang, Lei Zheng, Tao Zheng, Xi Wang, Zhuo Fan, Bing Han, Meiling Liu, Luyi Jiang, Dongming Shan, Wenzhong Jin, Jiwei
arxiv-2512-08674.description: Abstract Multimodal clinical reasoning in the field of gastrointestinal (GI) oncology necessitates the integrated interpretation of endoscopic imagery, radiological data, and biochemical markers. Despite the evident potential exhibited by Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), they frequently encounter challenges such as context dilution and hallucination when confronted with intricate, heterogeneous medical histories.

arxiv-2512-14411.title: Omnia: Synthetic Data Pipelines for Adaptive, Mission-Ready Militarized Humanoids Transforming first-person spatial data from smart glasses into synthetic training pipelines that accelerate humanoid autonomy and resilience.
arxiv-2512-14411.creator: Mohammed Ayman Habib, Aldo Petruzzelli
arxiv-2512-14411.description: Abstract I. INTRODUCTION At Omnia, we are developing a synthetic data–driven humanoid capability to accelerate both the baseline performance of militarized humanoids and the integration of advanced subsystems. Our core innovation is rapidly generating and refining high-fidelity training data from point-of-view (PoV) recordings, augmented reality headsets, and spatial browsing platforms.

pmc-11309259.title: Bleeding control of an injury to the infrarenal inferior vena cava and right external iliac vein by ipsilateral internal iliac artery and superficial femoral vein ligation after blunt abdominal trauma in Korea: a case report
pmc-11309259.creator: Hoonsung Park, Maru Kim, Dae-Sang Lee, Tae Hwa Hong, Doo-Hun Kim, Hangjoo Cho
pmc-11309259.description: Inferior vena cava (IVC) injuries, while accounting for fewer than 0.5% of blunt abdominal trauma cases, are among the most difficult to manage. Despite advancements in prehospital care, transportation, operative techniques, and perioperative management, the mortality rate for IVC injuries has remained at 20% to 66% for several decades.

pmc-11539650.title: Women's attitudes towards intimate partner violence in Guyana: a population-based study
pmc-11539650.creator: Gary Joseph, Charles C Branas, Sandra Rupnarain, Monica Riutort, Christopher N Morrison
pmc-11539650.description: SummaryBackgroundIntimate partner violence (IPV) against women is a global health issue and a breach of human rights. However, the literature lacks understanding of how socioeconomic and geographic disparities influence women's attitudes toward IPV in Guyana over time. This study aimed to assess trends in women's attitudes about IPV in Guyana.

pmc-11666570.title: Remodeling of tumour microenvironment: strategies to overcome therapeutic resistance and innovate immunoengineering in triple-negative breast cancer
pmc-11666570.creator: Desh Deepak Singh, Shafiul Haque, Youngsun Kim, Ihn Han, Dharmendra Kumar Yadav
pmc-11666570.description: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) stands as the most complex and daunting subtype of breast cancer affecting women globally. Regrettably, treatment options for TNBC remain limited due to its clinical complexity. However, immunotherapy has emerged as a promising avenue, showing success in developing effective therapies for advanced cases and improving patient outcomes.

pmc-12381058.title: Metabolic dysregulation in pulmonary fibrosis: insights into amino acid contributions and therapeutic potential
pmc-12381058.creator: Hongyu Zheng, Lei Zhang, Congjian Wang, Yi Wang, Chenxi Zeng
pmc-12381058.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is a progressive and life-threatening interstitial lung disease characterized by excessive extracellular matrix deposition and fibroblast activation. Emerging evidence suggests that amino acid metabolism plays a crucial role in the pathogenesis of pulmonary fibrosis. Key amino acids, including arginine, proline, and glutamine, contribute to the regulation of fibroblast activity and collagen synthesis, all of which are essential for fibrotic progression.

pmc-12729092.title: 4R-tau isoform induction via TDP-43 in neurons in response to insulin: converging signaling pathways with implications for neurodegenerative disease
pmc-12729092.creator: Carina Weissmann, Libia Catalina Salinas Castellanos, Mayra Micaela Montes, Gokhan Uruk, Hossam Youssef, R Ross Reichard, Rodolfo Gabriel Gatto, Keith A Josephs
pmc-12729092.description: Tau protein isoforms, regulated during development, are influenced by the nuclear factor TDP-43, which plays a crucial role in tau mRNA stability and exon 10 inclusion. Both tau and TDP-43 are prone to pathological phosphorylation and aggregation, with specific phosphorylated forms of TDP-43 linked to cytoplasmic mislocalization and alterations in the 3R/4R tau ratio as detected in different pathologies.

pmc-12750434.title: Changes in Gait After Training for Individuals With Cerebellar Ataxia
pmc-12750434.creator: Affan Smani, Seonjoo Lee, Michael Spinner, Scott Barbuto
pmc-12750434.description: ObjectiveTo investigate gait changes for individuals who performed either home aerobic or balance training.DesignSingle-blind randomized clinical trial.SettingHome training and outcome assessments at large, tertiary, urban hospital.ParticipantsIndividuals with cerebellar ataxia (N=52).InterventionsIndividuals in the aerobic group trained 30 minutes per session, 5 times per week at up to 85% predicted maximum heart rate.

pmc-13073161.title: Relationship Between ABO/Rh Blood Groups and Knee Osteoarthritis: A Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-13073161.creator: Gurkan Gumussuyu, Kaan Saritas, Belkis Koctekin, Serkan Gurcan, Ozkan Kose
pmc-13073161.description: Background/Objectives: The association between ABO/Rh blood groups and knee osteoarthritis (OA) remains controversial, with inconsistent findings reported across different populations. This study aimed to evaluate the distribution of ABO and Rh(D) blood groups in patients undergoing primary total knee arthroplasty (TKA) for primary knee OA and to compare these distributions with a regional external reference population.

pmc-13197278.title: Integrating lifestyle and clinical data in prostate cancer: expert assessment of a questionnaire
pmc-13197278.creator: Catarina Leitão, Luís Monteiro, Margarida Fardilha, Fátima Roque, Maria Teresa Herdeiro
pmc-13197278.description: PurposeProstate cancer (PCa) remains a significant health burden as one of the most common cancers among men worldwide. Given the growing evidence of lifestyle’s impact on PCa progression, this study evaluates multidisciplinary experts’ feedback on a novel questionnaire assessing lifestyle factors potentially influencing PCa progression.

pmc-13394673.title: Comparing the Effect of Semi‐Immersive Virtual Reality, Computerized Cognitive Training, and Traditional Rehabilitation on Cognitive Function in Multiple Sclerosis: A Randomized Clinical Trial
pmc-13394673.creator: Maria Grazia Maggio, Desiree Latella, Lilla Bonanno, Paulo Cezar Rocha dos Santos, Marcos Maldonado‐Díaz, Meir Plotnik, Rosaria De Luca, Angelo Quartarone, Rocco Salvatore Calabrò
pmc-13394673.description: BackgroundCognitive impairment is a common non‐motor symptom in Multiple Sclerosis (MS), negatively affecting autonomy and Quality of Life (QoL). Innovative rehabilitation strategies, such as semi‐immersive virtual reality (VR) and computerized cognitive training (CCT), may offer advantages over traditional cognitive rehabilitation (TCR), particularly in terms of engagement, specificity, adaptability, and ecological validity.

pmc-13589196.title: Interocular Symmetry in Anterior Segment Parameters in Children With Intermittent Exotropia Observed by CASIA2 AS‐OCT
pmc-13589196.creator: Jiawei Zhao, Xiaoli Qi, Xiaoyu Zeng, Song Lin, Kadiya Abudukeyimu, Luning Qin, Zong Yu, Nan Wei, Gang Ding, Xue Li, Jing Li, Ning Hua, Xuehan Qian
pmc-13589196.description: PurposeTo explore the interocular symmetry of the anterior segment parameters in subjects with intermittent exotropia (IXT) and compare it with that in the normal subjects.MethodsA total of 122 eyes of 61 subjects with IXT and 88 eyes of 44 normal subjects were enrolled.
